title: AI Search Visibility in Italia 2026
subtitle: 500 Italian queries across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI
description: Public research dataset from Telescop Research examining how commercial brands and sources appear across ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overview. The frozen design includes 500 Italian queries, four AI surfaces and three complete and separate runs, for 6,000 final observations. Canonical archived release: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22640375. Research report: https://telescop.it/research/ai-search-visibility-italia/ Author ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0003-6955-460X. GitHub companion: https://github.com/gentian-hajdaraj/ai-search-visibility-italia This public release supports replication of the research design, but does not include the original 6,000 raw responses, provider collection infrastructure, internal entity-linking/alias pipelines, or the complete production analysis code; exact output reproduction is therefore not expected.

userSpecifiedSources:
Original research produced by **Gentian Hajdaraj / Telescop Research**.

- Canonical archived release: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22640375
- Public research report: https://telescop.it/research/ai-search-visibility-italia/
- Methodology: https://telescop.it/research/ai-search-visibility-italia/methodology/
- GitHub companion: https://github.com/gentian-hajdaraj/ai-search-visibility-italia
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0003-6955-460X

The Kaggle dataset is a distribution mirror of selected public v1.0 research assets. The DOI-backed Zenodo record remains the canonical archival reference.

Replication scope: the frozen query panel, methodology summary, integrity checks and aggregate results are public. The original 6,000 raw responses, provider runtime, full entity-linking/alias pipeline, production semantic classifiers, complete deterministic QA/attribution logic and full production analysis code are not part of this public release. Independent reruns should be treated as replication studies rather than byte-for-byte reproduction of the published outputs.
